verdict.rationale: Check's docs have a dedicated page for an official command-line interface (CLI). It is built to query payroll data, automate workflows, and run in scripts and CI/CD pipelines. Output is JSON by default for piping through jq and Unix tools, and it has resource subcommands such as payments list/get/retry/refund/cancel. Missing for 10: install and authentication details, explicit agent-oriented usage guidance for the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
